command:
set -eu
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/activate-srv-data-lvm >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
backing=/var/lib/lvm-backing/srv-data.img
loopdev=$(/usr/sbin/losetup -j "$backing" | /usr/bin/awk -F: 'NR == 1 { print $1 }')
if [ -z "$loopdev" ]; then
    loopdev=$(/usr/sbin/losetup --find --show "$backing")
fi
/usr/sbin/lvmdevices --adddev "$loopdev" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
/usr/sbin/pvscan --cache "$loopdev" >/dev/null
/usr/sbin/vgchange -ay vg_srv >/dev/null
ANTRIEB_EOF
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/activate-srv-data-lvm
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach backing device and activate LVM for /srv/data
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-remount-fs.service
Before=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/activate-srv-data-lvm
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
if ! sudo awk '$2=="/srv/data"{found=1} END{exit !found}' /etc/fstab; then
  printf '%s\n' '/dev/mapper/vg_srv-data /srv/data xfs defaults,x-systemd.requires=srv-data-loop.service,x-systemd.after=srv-data-loop.service 0 0' | sudo tee -a /etc/fstab >/dev/null
fi
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable srv-data-loop.service
